root_direct_guest.scope: Root positive/denied selections are still separate. All motion imports unwind before root main calculates the official-layout CRC or calls ROS. The inline variant is retained as an independent build selection.

full_dependencies: Actual C compiler invocation must retain -MD -MF row.d -MT row.o and a fresh object. Preserve exact actual libm/libc/compiler-rt archive pins, target sysroot and compiler closure before/after; record actual linker --trace and the fresh full validator result. No unresolved placeholders are executable inputs.
authority: All modules start with zero ROS and WASI grants. Neither library may import ROS, WASI, env.tanh or an unlisted function. A retained pure static libm is not a host math import. No CRT, start section or constructor is accepted.
lifecycle: begin returns a nonzero generation only after the exact shared SDK kernel and twelve ordered actual Wasm callback calls. Generation never wraps. The callback checks a separate independently accumulated FNV value checksum, not an authentication credential. Main reads every field with immediate status==0, calls checked end even after a copy failure, and obtains no CRC/ROS side effect until the import stack is empty. Failed callback retirement poisons the instance for subsequent begins.
acceptance: Compilation and validation alone are not callback execution, native Unitree identity, ROS delivery, physics equivalence or physical robot qualification. Root must retain distinct Worker/Gateway/native participant processes and real native/simulator witnesses.
optimization_scope: The real Unitree preload/direct/native physics lane uses matched O3 and contraction-off. Existing independent synthetic 28-recipe O1 lessons remain unchanged and are not relabelled as an O3 performance baseline.
